_about: Bundled Super FUMBBL walk sheets (owner-original claude-v01 sets, Tier D). 1152x1024 = the 128 px PixelLab MASTERS (8 rows S,SE,E,NE,N,NW,W,SW x 9 cols, col 0 idle, 128 px frames drawn at HALF a world px per art px; the loader keeps the 64-unit layout grid via source.resolution). All 326 sheets are masters (art repo github.com/flutethecat/super-fumbbl-art, synced to a1eb46b2 on 2026-09-06: Blitzer-tier restage, Human/Orc/Necromantic sets, Orc fix round). The treeman tier (Altern x3 rosters, Loren; art repo bcf80c75, 2026-09-06) ships 144 px masters (1296x1152, manifest frame: 72, footY 68) drawn on the same grid — 1.125x the figure with no resampling. home = BLUE kit (claude-v01-blue for Human/Necro/Orc; recolor.py 352->225 'claude-v01-away' team-stage for the other 28 rosters), away = RED kit (claude-v01). Every roster ships both sides (owner 2026-09-05). STAR PLAYERS (2026-09-09): race 'stars' carries the 66 BB2025 star players (role = star name lower-cased a-z0-9; Deeproot/Maple on the 144 px treeman grid, frame 72). A star is resolved by its position NAME regardless of the hiring roster (bundledWalk.ts resolveBundledWalkRole falls through to 'stars'); games preload only the stars actually on the two rosters.
